note: Builds for Act 1's actors. Lore (names, races, roles, paths) comes from data/lore/characters.json; everything here (skill picks, numbers, foe stats, feature text) is Draft by Claude, tuned for four Unclassed heroes (6 HP, AC 10, attack +2/+3, 1d6+1 damage at Combat EL 0).

sellsword.name: Coldwater sellsword (dead)
sellsword.description: Three of them, in Coldwater colours, gnawed. One dropped a journal.

rat.name: Undercourse rat
rat.description: A sewer rat grown fat on refinery-warm run-off.
rat.tactics: Swarms the nearest hero. Flees when Old Gnaw falls.

rat_swarm.name: Rat swarm
rat_swarm.description: A carpet of small rats moving as one. Use it in place of three rats, or for the outer-tunnel culls.
rat_swarm.tactics: Engages everyone in its zone; each turn, one Bite against each hero Engaged with it (no multiple attack penalty).

old_gnaw.name: Old Gnaw
old_gnaw.description: A rat the size of a pony.
old_gnaw.tactics: Bites twice a turn (the second at -4) and uses its third action to Shove a hero out of the Engaged zone. Three rats come with it.

features.name: Shove (1 action)
features.text: One Engaged hero makes an Athletics or Acrobatics check against DC 12 or is pushed to Near.

gloam.name: the Gloam
gloam.description: Something made of dark and teeth.
gloam.tactics: The first fight is a rebuff: it ends after two rounds with the party thrown back to the doorway, and no one is lost. Its Coil and Throw does little damage; what it does is push.

attacks.name: Coil and Throw
attacks.traits: 1d4, the target is pushed to Far

features.name: Not There
features.text: Outside the sunlight, every hit passes through it: it takes no damage and is never Off-Guard.

features.name: Light-shy
features.text: It will not enter the square of sunlight under the grate, and flows around it every time. Caught in the light, it goes rigid.

light.name: Into the light
light.description: Get the Gloam into the shaft of sunlight before the sun moves off the floor.

approaches.label: Angle the light (the charge lamp's mirror, or pry the grate wider)
approaches.note: Full for Tinker, Half for others.

approaches.label: Rig a line to drag the grate cover
approaches.note: Full for Sailor. (Half for others is a Draft rule.)

approaches.label: Talk to Petra and read its pattern

setbacks.label: It lashes out
setbacks.text: The Gloam strikes the hero who failed. They take the damage, and one of their loaners is marked Damaged.

setbacks.label: The sun crawls
setbacks.text: End of the round: the light moves one step across the floor (the sun clock).

light.win: {gloam} is caught in the light, goes rigid, and comes apart into warm grey fog that settles in the water. {petra} is free.
light.lose: The light slides off the floor and up the wall. The Gloam uncoils. Draft: the party drags Petra out by the culvert and must come back at tomorrow's noon; the loaners are all Damaged.
